instruction: A boxy handheld game console rendered as a litho-printed tin toy, with a stamped faux-screen graphic, chunky embossed D-pad and buttons, and a fold-out wind-up key on the back. Scuffed teal-and-orange printed panels and riveted corners give it charming mid-century toy wear.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Handheld Game Console in a retro-tin-toy style. A boxy handheld game console rendered as a litho-printed tin toy, with a stamped faux-screen graphic, chunky embossed D-pad and buttons, and a fold-out wind-up key on the back. Scuffed teal-and-orange printed panels and riveted corners give it charming mid-century toy wear. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
